name: roblox-template
description: A small Rojo starter template for Roblox projects.

scripts.sourcemap: node tools/genRojoTree.js && rojo sourcemap default.project.json --output sourcemap.json
scripts.check: node tools/genRojoTree.js && stylua --check src && rojo sourcemap default.project.json --output sourcemap.json
scripts.build: node tools/genRojoTree.js && rojo build default.project.json -o place.rbxlx
